title: Plug the leak
description:
`average` allocates a temporary array, but two of its three ways out forget to free it. Every `new[]` needs a matching `delete[]` on **every** path.

Fix the function so that it never leaks. (The tidy fix is to free the memory in one place before returning the result, rather than sprinkling `delete[]` everywhere.)
hints: Check the arguments **before** allocating. Then there is only one path that owns memory, and it already frees it.
